lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Do not speak during the toll.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: The west gate was still taking people when the closure order came.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Mothers pressed their children beneath the black banners.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: And still the ash came.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
Custodian. Good. Help me finish the count.

Bell above. Fountain below. West gate where the frightened came through. Black banners at the doors.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
No.

The bell is wrong. The basin is wrong. There is no west gate.

Custodian... where did you bring me?

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
That one is a chapel bell.

The Ninth was Station Nine's Answer. Nine stations. Nine Answers.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
Eight answered.

Nine did not.

STATION IX: UNARRIVAL.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
An Answer that did not arrive inside its interval.

The station marked it: UNARRIVAL.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
For Station Nine, the interval stayed open.

People crossed. Freight crossed. Streets stopped agreeing.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Then Orra came.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
Name first. Wrist second.

When station records stopped agreeing with the people in front of them, we tied the name to the body.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
If it pulls tight, stop walking.

If it snaps, do not answer until they ask your station.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: If no one asks... do not answer at all.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
Precentor Orra. Meridian Office. Station Nine.

Saint came later.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
She was ordered straight to Nine.

The Lower Quarter had not cleared.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
She turned back for them.

Eight stations answered while she was gone. Nine did not.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
She abandoned Nine.

She brought people out.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
The interval opened.

She closed it.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: You tell me, Custodian.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Outside the white.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Easy. Do not pull the count apart.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Good. It still knows the difference.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
That wasn't a cord.

That was a name.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Do not turn around.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: This is a basin. It is not the Fountain.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text:
Wrong lip. Wrong depth. No east fracture.

The Fountain is where we counted the unburied.

This should not be here.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Step aside. The unburied are counted there.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: You stand where the empty coffins stood.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Take it. No sound will come.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: That is its mercy.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Set it deep.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Now let nothing answer.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: The count may still hold.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Custodian.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Then fear found you before understanding.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Go gently.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Some gates are closed by footsteps.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Enough.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: The thread has the count.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Answer nothing.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Still.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Back to the count.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Too early.

lines.speaker: Forlorn-Ritualant
lines.text: Now.
